messages:
Priya (Sales): Big customer (FinCorp) signed onto pilot but asked for full audit logs + ability to pin model versions. They want this in the pilot demo next week.
Maya (PM): Thats a heavy ask. Audit log surface is non-trivial (token-level vs event-level). Pinning model versions affects routing and rollout policy.
Sam (Eng): Tech feasibility: model pinning is doable (routing policy + pinned model label) but needs changes to the smart router and rollout infra. Audit logs require retention + redaction path.
Amit (Data): For audit logs we need to decide fields: request_id, user_id (hashed), model_id, prompt_hash, response_size, token_counts, timestamp. Redaction for PII would be mandatory for FinCust.
Nora (Legal): Legal says we can log metadata but must avoid storing full PII or raw user prompts without explicit consent. Need a consent checkbox + retention policy.
Priya (Sales): Customer insists this is non-negotiable for compliance sign-off. They said pilot is conditional.
Jordan (Product Lead): Two options: (A) Ship MVP as planned, mark audit logs + model pinning as v1 priorities and provide FinCorp a controlled pilot with a contractual workaround (on-prem/private deployment) or (B) Re-scope MVP to include a minimum audit surface + basic pinning and shift MVP date by 2 weeks.
Maya (PM): Cost of (B) = 2-week delay + 1 eng pair for 3 sprints to harden retention/consent. Risk = pushes other launch commitments.
Sam (Eng): Quick breakdown: pinning -> ~3 engineer-days (routing + API flag + tests). Minimal audit surface (event-level, no prompt body) -> ~5 engineer-days + storage. Full prompt redaction + retention -> longer.
Amit (Data): We could offer a "masked prompt hash" option: store prompt_hash and full prompt only when customer opts-in and is on Private. That reduces compliance risk for hosted pilot.
Nora (Legal): Masked prompt hash + documented retention and a consent flow should pass for pilot. On-prem still required for storing raw prompts.
Priya (Sales): Customer prefers hosted but willing to accept masked logs for pilot. They asked for SLA on pinned model behavior (no fallback without notify).
Jordan (Product Lead): Operational decision needed: allow pin with explicit fallback policy: if pinned model unavailable, we either 1) fail request (customer-visible error) or 2) fallback to compatible model and log event.
Sam (Eng): Failing request is safer for compliance but bad UX. Fallback + notification is typical for reliability. For pilot I'd recommend fail-on-pinned-miss and a clear error so FinCorp can test determinism.
Maya (PM): Proposed compromise: enable pinning in pilot with `pin_strict=true` opt-in per tenant. Default off. Provide masked audit events (no prompt bodies), retention set to 30 days, and require customer consent.
Jordan (Product Lead): That seems reasonable and keeps timeline tight. Action items: Sam -> implement pin_strict + API flag; Amit -> pipeline for masked audit events; Nora -> draft consent text and retention doc; Maya -> update pilot SOW and close loop with FinCorp.
Sam (Eng): I'll open PR today and include unit tests + a smoke script that toggles pin_strict.
Amit (Data): I'll create a small schema for masked events and a retention job: `retention_delete 30d` and a dashboard.
Nora (Legal): Draft ready, will post in thread by EOD. Need signoff from FinCorp legal for consent wording.
Priya (Sales): I'll get FinCorp OK on masked logs and pin_strict; they may accept pilot with these constraints.
deploy-bot: Release plan created: release/3278901234-pin-audit-pilot -> staging deploy queued
Maya (PM): Decision: proceed with pin_strict + masked audit events for hosted pilot. No MVP date shift. Revisit full audit scope in v1 planning.
Jordan (Product Lead): Please add monitoring alerts: pinned-model-miss rate, audit-event ingestion errors, and retention failures. Auto-fallback is off for pinned tenants.
Sam (Eng): Adding alerts and a canary rollout: 5 tenants -> 20 -> 100 -> all pinned tenants.
Maya (PM): Great — update the roadmap doc (MVP milestone) to mark "audit (masked) & strict pinning: pilot opt-in" and capture owners.
Priya (Sales): I'll confirm with FinCorp and update contract annex.
Jordan (Product Lead): Closing note: tactical scope extension for enterprise pilot, keep v1 for durability and full audit features.
Maya (PM): Thanks team. Will follow up with a short decision log in Notion and tag owners.
